evidence: The track starts at Andrews Shelter on Mount White Road, which turns off SH73, 24 km east of Arthur’s Pass.
The western end is at the Taramakau River valley, which meets Otira River at Aickens beside SH73, 25 km west of Arthur’s Pass.
Select the best place to cross the Otira River, aiming for the big orange triangle that indicates the track across farmland to SH73.

doubts: Start: no feature clearly is Andrews Shelter (the only road end F1 is Poulter River Track at Mt White Road, probably too far from Hallelujah Flat), so ref null. End: SH73 at Aickens has no entry. Day 1 ends at Casey Hut or Trust/Poulter Hut; the way is recorded via Trust/Poulter Hut since the next section starts there, and Casey Hut is a side trip. Kiwi Hut has no name entry. Taramakau River crossings are repeated crossings, listed once as a ford. From Townsend Creek the page offers Locke Stream Hut upstream (Harper Pass Route) or Kiwi Hut downstream; downstream taken as the route.
